1H.notes: Default nucleus. Thresholds are the values MRSIPrep has always used for proton MRSI; metabolite aliases resolve the common combined-resonance spellings against each other when locating input maps.
1H.source: MRSIPrep defaults, in use since the initial release.

31P.notes: Metabolite aliases are provided, but quality thresholds are NOT curated: 31P SNR/CRLB regimes differ substantially from 1H, and shipping guessed values would look authoritative while being wrong. Pass --snr-min/--linewidth-max/--crlb-max explicitly, or contribute citation-backed defaults here.

2H.notes: Deuterium metabolic imaging (DMI). As for 31P, thresholds are deliberately uncurated -- deuterium SNR is far lower than proton and appropriate cutoffs are protocol-specific. Pass the three quality flags explicitly, or contribute curated values.
